```{r load libraries}
library(ggplot2)

```

```{r load data}

TAC_calculated <- read.csv("Output/Fall_2025/assays/TAC_calculated_means.csv") # means file is the mean gtwn duplicates per indiv
MDA_calculated <- read.csv("Output/Fall_2025/assays/MDA_calculated_means.csv") # means file is the mean gtwn duplicates per indiv

TAC_calculated.all <- read.csv("Output/Fall_2025/assays/TAC_calculated_all.csv") # means file is the mean gtwn duplicates per indiv

```


# PLOTS 

```{r plot TAC  and MDA}
# relevel the treatment factors for the main plot 
MDA_calculated$Timepoint <- factor(MDA_calculated$Timepoint, 
                                                       levels = c("post-prime", 
                                                                  "1 week recovery, post challenge", 
                                                                  "3 weeks recovery, post challenge"))

MDA_calculated$Prime_treatment <- factor(MDA_calculated$Prime_treatment, 
                                                       levels = c("0_hours", 
                                                                  "24_hours", 
                                                                  "72_hours"))


TAC_calculated$Timepoint <- factor(TAC_calculated$Timepoint, 
                                                       levels = c("post-prime", 
                                                                  "1 week recovery, post challenge", 
                                                                  "3 weeks recovery, post challenge"))

TAC_calculated$Prime_treatment <- factor(TAC_calculated$Prime_treatment, 
                                                       levels = c("0_hours", 
                                                                  "24_hours", 
                                                                  "72_hours"))

# plot
MDA_TAC_plot.all <- ggpubr::ggarrange(
                      ggplot(TAC_calculated.all,
                              aes(x = as.factor(Oyster_ID), 
                               y = mM_CRE_permgProtein)) + 
                        geom_point(),
                      
                      ggplot(MDA_calculated.all,
                              aes(x = as.factor(Oyster_ID), 
                               y = mM_MDA_permgProtein)) + 
                        geom_point(),
                      nrow=2)

MDA_calculated.OM <- MDA_calculated %>%  dplyr::filter(!mM_MDA_permgProtein.mean >0.6)
TAC_calculated.OM <- TAC_calculated %>%  dplyr::filter(!mM_CRE_permgProtein.mean >12)


MDA_TAC_plot <- ggpubr::ggarrange(
  
        ggplot(data = (TAC_calculated.OM %>% dplyr::filter(!mM_CRE_permgProtein.mean < 0)),

                                          ) +

      ggplot(data = MDA_calculated.OM, 
                                         aes(x=Prime_treatment, 
                                             y = mM_MDA_permgProtein.mean, 
                                              group =  Timepoint,
                                              shape = Prime_treatment,
                                              color = Prime_treatment)) +
                                          stat_summary(
                                            fun = mean,
                                            geom = "point",
                                            size = 3
                                          ) +
                                          stat_summary(
                                            fun.data = mean_se,
                                            geom = "errorbar",
                                            width = 0.2
                                          ) +
                                          scale_color_manual(values = c("#D55E00", "#E69F00", "#009E73")) +
                                          labs(
                                             x = "Sublethal prime (duration under 33C)",
                                             y = "mM MDA mg protein-1",

                                           )  +
                                          facet_wrap(~Timepoint, nrow = 1)+#, strip.position = "right") +
                                          theme_classic() +

                                          #coord_flip(),
       
      
    
nrow =2)
 

pdf("Output/Fall_2025/assays/TAC_MDA_plot.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
```

```{r TAC stats}

# ANOVA post prime :::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::
ANOVA.TACprime <- aov(
                      lm(
                        mM_CRE_permgProtein.mean ~ Prime_treatment,
                         data = (TAC_calculated.OM %>%  dplyr::filter(Timepoint %in% 'post-prime'))
                      )
                    )
shapiro.test(resid(ANOVA.TACprime)) # 0.5764 - normal
car::leveneTest(ANOVA.TACprime) # 0.7076 - homogeneity variance

summary(ANOVA.TACprime)
#                 Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)  
# Prime_treatment  2  12.99   6.494   10.62 0.0107 * SIGNIFICANT EFFECT
# Residuals        6   3.67   0.612  
TukeyHSD(ANOVA.TACprime)
# $Prime_treatment
#                         diff        lwr        upr     p adj
# 24_hours-0_hours  -2.7381787 -4.5708421 -0.9055154 0.0089359
# 72_hours-0_hours  -0.8792858 -2.9573307  1.1987592 0.4461819
# 72_hours-24_hours  1.8588929 -0.3315587  4.0493446 0.0894486



# ANOVA after lethal challenge (1 week recovery after primed) ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::
ANOVA.TAC1week <- aov(
                      lm(
                        mM_CRE_permgProtein.mean ~ Prime_treatment,
                         data = (TAC_calculated.OM %>%  dplyr::filter(Timepoint %in% '1 week recovery, post challenge'))
                      )
                    )
shapiro.test(resid(ANOVA.TAC1week)) # 0.7303 - normal
car::leveneTest(ANOVA.TAC1week) # 0.4039 - homogeneity variance

summary(ANOVA.TAC1week)
#                 Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)  
# Prime_treatment  2  29.39   14.70   3.983  0.063 . MARGINAL EFFECT
# Residuals        8  29.52    3.69  




# ANOVA after lethal challenge (3 weeks recovery after primed) ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::
ANOVA.TAC3weeks <- aov(
                      lm(
                        mM_CRE_permgProtein.mean ~ Prime_treatment,
                         data = (TAC_calculated.OM %>%  dplyr::filter(Timepoint %in% '3 weeks recovery, post challenge'))
                      )
                    )
shapiro.test(resid(ANOVA.TAC3weeks)) # 0.09657 - normal
car::leveneTest(ANOVA.TAC3weeks) # 0.7121 - homogeneity variance
summary(ANOVA.TAC3weeks)
#                 Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
# Prime_treatment  2  1.618  0.8089     0.4  0.683
# Residuals        8 16.167  2.0208  

```

```{r MDA stats}

# ANOVA post prime :::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::
ANOVA.MDAprime <- aov(
                      lm(
                        mM_MDA_permgProtein.mean ~ Prime_treatment,
                         data = (MDA_calculated.OM %>%  dplyr::filter(Timepoint %in% 'post-prime'))
                      )
                    )
shapiro.test(resid(ANOVA.MDAprime)) # 0.9934 - normal
car::leveneTest(ANOVA.MDAprime) # 0.1573 - homogeneity variance
summary(ANOVA.MDAprime)
#                 Df   Sum Sq   Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
# Prime_treatment  2 0.000232 0.0001158   0.115  0.894
# Residuals        6 0.006054 0.0010090 




# ANOVA after lethal challenge (1 week recovery after primed) ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::
ANOVA.MDA1week <- aov(
                      lm(
                        mM_MDA_permgProtein.mean ~ Prime_treatment,
                         data = (MDA_calculated.OM %>%  dplyr::filter(Timepoint %in% '1 week recovery, post challenge'))
                      )
                    )
shapiro.test(resid(ANOVA.MDA1week)) # 0.4122 - non normal
car::leveneTest(ANOVA.MDA1week) # 0.6627 - homogeneity variance
summary(ANOVA.MDA1week)
#                 Df  Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)  
# Prime_treatment  2 0.02706 0.01353   5.263 0.0478 * SIGNIFICANT EFFECT
# Residuals        6 0.01542 0.00257 
TukeyHSD(ANOVA.MDA1week)
# $Prime_treatment
#                          diff          lwr        upr     p adj
# 24_hours-0_hours   0.13690537 -0.005095238 0.27890598 0.0572940
# 72_hours-0_hours   0.03681948 -0.097894127 0.17153309 0.6948564
# 72_hours-24_hours -0.10008589 -0.218892125 0.01872034 0.0916376



# ANOVA after lethal challenge (3 weeks recovery after primed) ::::::::::::::::::::::::::::
ANOVA.MDA3weeks <- aov(
                      lm(
                        mM_MDA_permgProtein.mean ~ Prime_treatment,
                         data = (MDA_calculated.OM %>%  dplyr::filter(Timepoint %in% '3 weeks recovery, post challenge'))
                      )
                    )
shapiro.test(resid(ANOVA.MDA3weeks)) # 0.2585 - normal
car::leveneTest(ANOVA.MDA3weeks) # 0.3492 - homogeneity variance
summary(ANOVA.MDA3weeks)
#                 Df  Sum Sq  Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
# Prime_treatment  2 0.00643 0.003214   0.498  0.625
# Residuals        8 0.05162 0.006452 


```


```{r posthoc tests}

# TAC prime effect
ANOVA.TACprime.TUKEY <- TukeyHSD(ANOVA.TACprime)
ANOVA.TACprime.TUKEY.emm <- emmeans::emmeans(ANOVA.TACprime, ~ Prime_treatment)
multcomp::cld(ANOVA.TACprime.TUKEY.emm, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters)
#                         diff        lwr       upr     p adj
# 24_hours-72_hours -1.8588929 -4.0493446 0.3315587 0.0894486
# 0_hours-72_hours   0.8792858 -1.1987592 2.9573307 0.4461819
# 0_hours-24_hours   2.7381787  0.9055154 4.5708421 0.0089359

# Prime_treatment emmean    SE df lower.CL upper.CL .group
# 24_hours          6.94 0.452  6     5.46     8.42  a    
# 72_hours          8.80 0.553  6     6.99    10.61  ab   
# 0_hours           9.68 0.391  6     8.40    10.96   b  


# MDA chalelnge effect after 1 week recovery post prime
ANOVA.MDA1week.TUKEY <- TukeyHSD(ANOVA.MDA1week)
ANOVA.MDA1week.TUKEY.emm <- emmeans::emmeans(ANOVA.MDA1week, ~ Prime_treatment)
multcomp::cld(ANOVA.MDA1week.TUKEY.emm, adjust = "tukey", Letters = letters)
#                          diff         lwr         upr     p adj
# 24_hours-72_hours  0.10008589 -0.01872034 0.218892125 0.0916376
# 0_hours-72_hours  -0.03681948 -0.17153309 0.097894127 0.6948564
# 0_hours-24_hours  -0.13690537 -0.27890598 0.005095238 0.0572940

# Prime_treatment emmean     SE df lower.CL upper.CL .group
# 0_hours          0.111 0.0358  6 -0.00658    0.228  a    
# 72_hours         0.148 0.0253  6  0.06461    0.231  a    
# 24_hours         0.248 0.0293  6  0.15186    0.344  a  

```
